message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision for this Monopoly turn.

I'm p3 with $641 and a dark blue monopoly. All four properties are mortgaged. I plan to unmortgage them and build one house on each property for $400. This leaves about $241.

Two houses on the dark blues would yield $500 and $600 in rent. I'm assessing the danger from p1's orange monopoly and p2's pink monopoly.

p2's pink properties with three houses each cost $450 to $500 in rent. p4 has $61 cash and owns hotels on Med and Baltic plus three railroads. Ventnor is unmortgaged and p4 holds one house on Connecticut.

I just paid $22 rent at Ventnor. I cannot afford three houses on both dark blues because that would cost another $400. I will build two houses on each property and leave $241.

Monopoly requires buildings to stay even. A 3/2 split is legal but leaves only $41 cash, which is too risky. I will stick with the 2/2 plan.

I calculated that p1's New York with three houses costs $600. That exceeds my remaining cash of $241. I would need to sell houses to pay rent. Selling two houses returns $200. I must sell all houses before mortgaging.

Selling all four houses would leave $41 after paying a $600 rent. That is survivable but leaves me stripped.

I am now considering p4's position on the CHANCE space. Their next roll could land them on dangerous properties.

I am weighing a 3/2 split on the dark blues. It would cost $600 and leave only $41 cash, but it would force p4 and p2 to liquidate their hotels.

I recalled the exact dark blue rent schedule. Three houses on Park Place would cost $1,100 and three on Boardwalk $1,400. That would force me to sell everything if I hit either property.

From Ventnor, rolling a 2 lands on Water Works, which is mortgaged and yields no rent. Rolling a 3 lands on Marvin Gardens, which is also mortgaged. Rolling a 4 sends me to Jail.

The remaining rolls from Ventnor are mostly safe. Rolling a 5 lands on Pacific Avenue. Rolling a 6 hits North Carolina, but p4 lacks the full green monopoly there, so rent is only $20. Rolling an 8 lands on Pennsylvania Avenue, which is mortgaged and yields no rent. Rolling an 11 lands on Park Place, my own property. The worst possible hit is the Luxury Tax of $75, which my $241 cash easily covers.

I will not unmortgage the dark blues. The total cost is roughly $527, leaving no cash for building. I also rejected p4's trade offer to exchange Pacific Avenue for Ventnor, since that would complete their green monopoly.

I cannot afford to unmortgage yellows and build there. I will build the dark blue houses now before ending my turn, since p4 is next.

I will submit a build plan containing both houses in one action. I am drafting a public message about the upgrade and checking the schema.
